c1-g1.draft: SELECT tracking_code, status FROM shipments WHERE status = 'delivered' ORDER BY id;

c1-g2.draft: SELECT id, weight_kg FROM shipments WHERE status = 'queued' AND weight_kg >= 500 ORDER BY id;

c1-g3.draft: SELECT id, route_id, booked_at FROM shipments WHERE route_id IN (2, 4) AND booked_at BETWEEN '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z' AND '2026-01-31T23:59:59.999999Z' ORDER BY id;
